allow: PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -ge 3000 -and $_.LocalPort -le 3200 } | Select-Object LocalPort, OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { $_.LocalPort; \(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).ProcessName })
PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 3000,3001 } | Select-Object LocalPort, OwningProcess)
